title: The Seven Witnesses of the Dream
summary: Seven witnesses approach the same anomaly through archaeology, neuroscience, acoustics, narrative, HCI, systems ecology, and local memory without forcing their accounts into one explanation.

links.note: The seven perspectives converge on the underground network without becoming one account.
The evidence-sharing method anticipates Alpha One's distributed validation model.
Different stories remaining around one question anticipates the Common Center.

prompt.en: Riha is the spirit of what? Write the first word that comes to mind.
